Nearby search: Mississauga preview

Supported postal codes: L5B 3C9 (Celebration Square), L5B 3C1 (Civic Centre), and L5G 1C8 (Port Credit Library).

We use the named public landmark for each code, not your exact location. Distances are approximate straight-line distances to Celebration Square, where pre-parade activities begin. Your selected radius is applied to that distance, not walking, driving, or the parade route. Age is checked against the listing’s all-ages eligibility. Nothing you enter is saved.
